assignments.reason: Emunah (faith) is the eitza-source node in both cause/effect edges of Torah #64. Its essential nature in this Torah is the supreme holy capacity to transcend all wisdoms and heresies — including those of the chalal ha-panui — without rational investigation. The additions file already placed 'rosh emunah' (supreme faith) in Package 2, identifying it as the pinnacle of the silence/Moses cluster. General emunah shares this essential nature: it is the mode of being above speech and rational discourse, which is precisely the defining quality of Package 2 (shitika u-Moshe). The Torah states (line 13): 'Israel through emunah pass over all wisdoms... only through complete faith' — emunah is the holy faculty that operates where speech cannot, the same domain as Moses/silence/kevad peh. It does not belong in Package 1 (the neutral void structure) nor Package 3 (evil). Its essential nature is holy transcendence above verbal-rational comprehension.

assignments.node_id: עוברים על כל החכמות והקשיות והאפיקורסית הבא משם מחלל הפנוי
assignments.reason: This node describes the holy act of 'passing over all wisdoms, difficulties, and heresy that comes from the chalal ha-panui.' Its essential nature is the positive, holy capacity to transcend the unanswerable questions of the void through faith rather than rational inquiry. This is the practical expression of the shitika (silence) principle: one does not attempt to answer these questions with speech/intellect but rather passes over them in silence and faith. The Torah (line 16) connects this directly to emunah and to the principle that 'one must only believe and be silent there' (line 24: 'tzarich rak le-ha'amin ve-lishtok sham'). The act of 'passing over' IS the act of holy silence before the unknowable — the defining quality of Package 2. It does not belong in Package 1 (neutral void structure) because it is not a parallel aspect of the void but a holy response to it.

assignments.node_id: עוברים על כל החכמות, ואפלו על האפיקורסית הזאת הבא מחלל הפנוי
assignments.reason: This is a variant formulation of the same concept as the previous node — 'passing over all wisdoms, even the heresy that comes from the chalal ha-panui.' The word 'va-afilu' (even) emphasizes that this transcendence reaches even the most dangerous second type of heresy. Its essential nature is identical: the holy act of transcending through faith and silence rather than speech. The Torah (line 13) states this explicitly in the context of Israel's faith: 'Israel through emunah pass over all wisdoms, even this heresy that comes from the chalal ha-panui, because they believe in Hashem without any investigation or wisdom, only through complete faith.' This is the quintessence of the shitika principle — Package 2's defining quality.
